shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,160p' package.json && rg -n \"ToolRegistry|inputSchema|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation\" src --glob '*test.ts' --glob '*test.tsx'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg -n \"@spec|specs/.+#[0-9]+|spec:\" src --glob '*test.ts' | head -80 && rg -n \"Ajv|ajv\" package-lock.json | head -20 && git log --oneline -5"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"spec.*anchor|@spec|validated by\" scripts .lore src --glob '"'!src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts'"' | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,70p' package-lock.json && git diff -- package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): validate required input before execution" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
